comparison.objective: Lay logs across a bog and push a rover to the far bank; candidate commissions an adjustable shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Large-object terrain construction and vehicle pushing versus precision hex-key use, fine rotational adjustment, counterholding, and guarded control actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Rover must cross onto the far bank using the laid logs; candidate requires repeated energy-absorbing stops within stroke and a locked setting. No detailed crossing rubric/spec is available.
comparison.reason: Terrain bridging and locomotion assistance do not test mechanical damping adjustment or setting retention.
